context.text: Ethereal = +50 % Defense or base Weapon Damage, cannot be repaired, durability (max/2)+1; a Zod socket or an Indestructible runeword (BotD, Void) removes the drawback (durability-quantity 2026-02-10). context.text: Sockets = "Runes must be placed in a specific Base Item type with the EXACT amount of Sockets" (runewords 2026-06-02). Max sockets depend on ilvl (table ilvl 1–25 / 26–40 / 41+; "Normal Difficulty has a maximum of 3 Sockets", Nightmare 4, Hell no limit; 1/3 of eligible drops are socketed — sockets 2026-06-16). A drop's socket count is fixed unless it is 0. Superior below 15 ED has its own cohort; it neither inherits the perfect-roll premium nor automatically equals normal quality. Cached October 3/4 SC/NL/PC/RotW 3os non-ethereal Mage Plate asks have Q1 0.294 Ist / 21 normal sellers versus 0.785 Ist / five ordinary-superior sellers (5–14 ED); these are cohort asks, not exact-ED premiums or sales.
